verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents team comments and @mention that let teammates jointly discuss and gain access to an email thread, giving some shared visibility into conversations, but this is lightweight collaboration on individual inboxes rather than a true shared/team inbox with unified conversation state. A community power-user explicitly noted uncertainty whether Shortwave's Bundles/Workspaces could replace dedicated 'Team Inboxes' like Front's, suggesting the core shared-inbox-account use case is not clearly delivered. Missing for 10: dedicated shared/team inbox accounts with synchronized read/assigned state, confirmation that Bundles/Workspaces fully substitute for Team Inboxes, independent hands-on validation of shared-state behavior across team members.
